Queens, NYC - Swastikas were sprayed across multiple synagogues and Jewish sites yesterday in a neighborhood with a large Jewish population.
Sadly, one of the swastikas was defaced onto a cornerstone dedicated to Kristallnacht survivors, a direct, chilling echo of Nazi violence.
Nearby, the Rego Park Jewish Center was also vandalized with "Heil Hitler" graffiti.
